text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — autoscaler failing to attach GPUs in gcp-asia-south1; recent 5m queue growth 18k reqs, attach errors 84% (acceleratorQuotaExceeded).
sophia (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing cluster and quota logs. opening bridge.
matt (infra): saw quota denies from compute.googleapis.com: 'Insufficient accelerators available' across two projects (redwood-prod and rw-edge).
ryan (sre): can we fall back to smaller instance families or fallback pool in us-central1? customer impact mounting, some requests 504.
alia (platform): Starting immediate routing rule: non-critical background embeddings -> fallback model hosted in us-west2 to reduce asia-south1 load. Will post config.
eng-api: pushing a soft throttle on low-priority routes (rate limit 50% for embeddings batch jobs) — patching ingress now.
matt (infra): quick check: running `gcloud compute regions describe asia-south1 --project=redwood-prod` shows acceleratorLimits saturated; quota request already in flight but not approved yet.
ryan (sre): can someone post the exact attach error logs? need HPA status and node-pool errors.
sophia (oncall): logs: ```
E0322 10:12:03.123 kubelet_attach.go:217] attach failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = acceleratorQuotaExceeded: requested 4xA100, available 0
E0322 10:12:03.124 autoscaler.go:548] scale-up failed: container creation backlog increasing
```
alia (platform): mitigation plan: 1) reroute low-priority -> us-west2 (in progress), 2) enable quantized model variant for chat-highmem to reduce vram per replica, 3) request emergency quota increase with GCP SA escalation (matt/ryan).
sophia (oncall): I've notified customers on status page: "Degraded performance for Asia customers; mitigation underway."
matt (infra): filing emergency quota request now — using org-level billing contact and CCing GCP TAM. command: `gcloud alpha services quota-requests create --project=redwood-prod --region=asia-south1 --resource=accelerator.googleapis.com/A100 --amount=40 --priority=critical`
ryan (sre): while we wait, can we spin up preemptible A40s in ap-northeast1 as temporary? costy but fast. any inter-region latency concerns?
eng-api: yes latency increased ~40-80ms for users routed to us-west2; acceptable for embeddings but not for low-latency chat sessions. we'll split by route.
alia (platform): I deployed a canary rollback route to use smaller LLM variant for 20% of chat traffic in asia-south1 to reduce per-request GPU time. monitors in place.
sophia (oncall): ops-bot, start incident timer and create postmortem doc draft.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0422-asia-gpu-quota. Postmortem draft at /confluence/incidents/INC-2026-0422.
matt (infra): GCP replied: "We've received your quota request; reviewing - ETA 2h." escalation email sent.
ryan (sre): ETA >1h unacceptable. propose: enable KV cache TTL extension and reduce batch window to free up capacity immediately. who can change batch config?
eng-api: I'm toggling batch.window from 300ms -> 100ms for chat routes in asia-south1. patch applied.
sophia (oncall): early telemetry: queue length down 30%, attach errors -> 52% after throttles + routing. errors still present but improving.
alia (platform): enabling quantized variant reduced memory per replica by ~35%; we can fit ~1.6x replicas per node. scheduling improvement obvious.
matt (infra): spun up a temporary smaller nodepool in ap-southeast1 with 8 x T4s to accept overflow using cross-region routing. provisioning succeeded.
ryan (sre): monitoring for tail latency and error budgets — setting alert if 5xx > 5% for more than 5m.
sophia (oncall): customer impact summary for status page: "Partial degradation in Asia region — some requests degraded to fallback model, increased latency for chat. No data loss."
eng-api: rolling back rate-limits gradually as queue stabilizes.
matt (infra): GCP approved partial quota bump for testing +20 A100 equiv for 45 minutes (temp increase). applying to redwood-prod.
alia (platform): note: need to update our runbook to include pre-approved cross-region fallback pool and a matrix of model-variant fallbacks. filing a follow-up action.
sophia (oncall): handoff to night oncall @ryan in 25m. please capture remaining tasks: confirm quota permanent increase, finalize postmortem, complete follow-up items.
ryan (sre): taking over. current status: queue trending down, attach errors <20% now, overflow pool healthy, customer-impact page updated. I'll keep bridge open for 2h.
sophia (oncall): thanks team. :thumbsup: closing pager for primary oncall.
incidentbot: Pager resolved (ack by sophia). Bridge remains open under monitor by ryan.
ops-bot: Actions created: ["request-perm-quota-increase","update-fallback-runbook","postmortem-draft-review"] assigned to matt/alia/sophia.
sophia (oncall): postmortem skeleton ready — adding timelines and telemetry snapshots. will ping for review.
ryan (sre): will update status page when bridge closes.
eng-api: noted lessons — expose per-route quota telemetry in console to avoid blind spots.
alia (platform): noting follow-up: runbook change, preapproved budget for emergency cross-region fallbacks, and contract with cloud TAM for faster quota handling.
sophia (oncall): closing thread; continuing postmortem work in doc.
